item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 18/May/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon affecting Guangdong will moderate gradually in the next couple of days. Troughs of low pressure are expected to affect southern China and the northern part of the South China Sea in the latter part of this week to early next week. The weather will be unsettled with thundery showers over the region.
